fit_reason: Whole passenger car (2004 Chevy Malibu sedan) listed by a private owner in cars by owner.
findings: Headlight lenses look slightly hazy and yellowed at the front corners
White paint looks clean but somewhat flat, with little gloss on the hood and side panels
Light road grime along the lower rocker panels and door bottoms
No interior photos, so the leather and cabin condition can't be judged
message: Hi, we saw your listing for the Malibu LTZ. The paint looks clean, but the headlight lenses look a little hazy and the white could use some gloss to pop in photos. We do pre-sale details that come to you, including headlight restoration and a wash and wax, and can do the leather interior too. Would you like a quote?
